club.description: Sherwood Foresters draws its identity from Nottingham's connection to Sherwood Forest and the woodland traditions of Nottinghamshire. The club brings the imagery of ancient oaks and forest paths into the everyday life of the city's communities, creating a character rooted in both local heritage and urban football.

descriptions.de: Sherwood Foresters schöpft seine Identität aus Nottinghams Verbindung zum Sherwood Forest und den Waldtraditionen von Nottinghamshire. Der Verein bringt die Bilder alter Eichen und Waldwege in den Alltag der städtischen Gemeinschaften ein und verbindet so lokales Erbe mit urbanem Fußball.
descriptions.es: Sherwood Foresters se inspira en el vínculo de Nottingham con el bosque de Sherwood y las tradiciones forestales de Nottinghamshire. El club lleva la imagen de robles centenarios y senderos del bosque a la vida cotidiana de las comunidades urbanas, forjando una identidad arraigada tanto en el patrimonio local como en el fútbol de la ciudad.
descriptions.fr: Sherwood Foresters puise son identité dans le lien entre Nottingham, la forêt de Sherwood et les traditions forestières du Nottinghamshire. Le club fait entrer l'image des chênes séculaires et des sentiers forestiers dans le quotidien des habitants, unissant patrimoine local et football urbain.
descriptions.it: Sherwood Foresters trae la propria identità dal legame di Nottingham con la foresta di Sherwood e le tradizioni boschive del Nottinghamshire. Il club porta l'immagine delle querce secolari e dei sentieri forestali nella vita quotidiana delle comunità cittadine, creando un carattere radicato sia nel patrimonio locale sia nel calcio urbano.
descriptions.en: Sherwood Foresters draws its identity from Nottingham's connection to Sherwood Forest and the woodland traditions of Nottinghamshire. The club brings the imagery of ancient oaks and forest paths into the everyday life of the city's communities, creating a character rooted in both local heritage and urban football.
